name: Arcane Feedback Trap

source.title: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven

disable: DC 33 Arcana check (master) to quell the rippling stone or Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 31) to dispel the magical feedback.

items.name: Stone Spike
items.text:
Trigger A creature in area E1 casts an arcane spell or uses an arcane ability

---

Effect The trap makes a stone spike attack against the triggering creature. For the next 1 minute thereafter, the ripples are stronger, giving the trap a +2 circumstance bonus on stone spike Strikes during this time.

text: A spike of stone bursts from the south wall and quickly retracts.
